phases.name: A Lovers' Quarrel
phases.say: (They turn on each other, and then, together, on you.)

say.open: Stay. Stay with us. Why would you ever go home?

bestiary.lore: The card of choice and union, made flesh twice over: a pair of tempters who will have one of you, whichever you choose.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, heavily. Guard the strongest from the whispers.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn a whisper charms the strongest; heartbreak on a row and a leaping poisoned kiss on the Back between. At the quarrel, the whispers come every other turn.
